defs.def: a type of soft white stone 白垩

ex.s: In primary school, I learned to write using chalks.
ex.t: 在小学里，我学会了用粉笔写字。

ex.s: Although I have enjoyed breaking my decades-long taboo about working with oil paints, I have discovered I now prefer chalks and ink.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画颜料的禁忌，但我发现我现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

defs.def: a substance similar to chalk made into white or coloured sticks for writing or drawing （白色或彩色的）粉笔

ex.s: Mr Dena kept an unforgettable ___41___ by Sir Isaac Newton on his chalk board: “If I have been able to see further, it is only because I stand on the shoulders of giants.” He reflected on that throughout the year and was ___42___ to teach us more than math.

ex.t: 有一次，我们在___42___粉笔溪边露营。
